summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its periodic Total Voting Rights and Capital notification under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules, dated 30 September 2026. The bank disclosed 7,941,695,558 ordinary shares outstanding (excluding 178,249,802 treasury shares), each carrying four voting rights, producing 31,768,714,792 total voting rights, plus 240,686 11% and 242,454 5.5% cumulative preference shares. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is present; shareholders use the figure for interest-disclosure calculations. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
